# iru_device_note (Resource)

Manages one note on an Iru device. It changes only that note; the device itself is never modified, and destroy deletes only the note.

Notes written in the Iru UI are stored as HTML. A note whose text matches `content` apart from HTML markup does not show as drift.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "iru_device_note" "loaner" {
  device_id = iru_device.loaner.id
  content   = "Loaner for the QA team. Return to IT by end of quarter."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `content` (String) Note text.
- `device_id` (String) ID of the device the note is on. Changing it moves the note: a new note is created and the old one deleted.

### Read-Only

- `author` (String) Who wrote the note.
- `created_at` (String) When the note was created.
- `id` (String) Composite identifier `device_id:note_id`.
- `note_id` (String) Note ID.
- `updated_at` (String) When the note was last changed.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = iru_device_note.loaner
  identity = {
    device_id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
    note_id   = "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `device_id` (String) ID of the device the note is on.
- `note_id` (String) Note ID.

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = iru_device_note.loaner
  id = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Notes are imported by device ID and note ID, separated by a colon.
terraform import iru_device_note.loaner 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000:11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111
```
